name: codex-auto-router
description: Start from Codex, classify the pending task in ChatGPT, then route it back to the cheapest sufficient Codex tier.

interface.shortDescription: Route pending local Codex tasks through ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex launcher captures the current task and project context, ChatGPT chooses the cheapest sufficient tier through the connected MCP bridge, and the launcher resumes into Codex with that model and reasoning effort.
defaultPrompt: Choose the cheapest sufficient tier for the pending local Codex request.
Route this Codex task without spending a separate Codex turn on classification.
